items.name: Brisbane's 20 in 20 in 2020
items.information: It's 2020, which only means one thing: time for a NON-STOP 20 HOUR COMPETITION with exactly 20 ROUNDS. Yes, we're a bit crazy, but it's going to be awesome. Note that the main events will occur during the middle of the 20 hours, such that most competitors should only need to be present during the more regular hours of the day. For more informations, please look at the [FAQ page](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Brisbanes20in20in2020#13966-faq) and [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Brisbanes20in20in2020#competition-schedule). ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

items.name: Texas Cubing Summer Dallas 2020
items.information: # The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. ***Please note that this schedule is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.*** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition.
